description: This file defines an interface for event listeners within the Fineract project. It provides a contract for classes that want to be notified when a Business Event occurs, such as after loan approval events.

classes.name: BusinessEventListener
classes.description: Interface to be implemented by classes that want to be informed when a Business Event executes. It includes a method 'onBusinessEvent' which is called with the event object after execution.

methods.name: onBusinessEvent
methods.description: Callback method invoked after a Business Event has been executed. It takes a generic type extending BusinessEvent.
